name: workflow
description: Run an ordered pipeline of sub-agent steps. Each step spawns a child session through the same machinery as `subagent_new`, so every step shows up in your panel as a sub-session card. Steps run sequentially: the previous step's final reply is substituted for `{prev}` in the next step's `task` (use `{prev}` once per step where you want it). The workflow tool returns the LAST step's reply concatenated with brief per-step headers, so you keep the audit trail in your context. Use this when you have a fixed pipeline of specialist agents — e.g. researcher → critic → drafter — and don't want to call `subagent_new` three times by hand. For one-shot delegations, prefer `subagent_new`. Each step accepts `mode` (explorer for sandboxed reads, executor for write access; default executor) and `agent` (any agent name in agenthub/; defaults to your own). Backgroundable: set `run_in_background=true` to fire-and-forget the whole pipeline and continue working while it runs.

name.description: Short display name for this step (≤ 40 chars). Shown as the sub-session label.

agent.description: Agent name in agenthub/ to spawn for this step. Optional; defaults to the calling agent.

task.description: Step prompt. Use the literal token {prev} where you want the previous step's final reply spliced in. The first step's {prev} resolves to an empty string.

mode.description: explorer = sandboxed (writes only inside the child's playground/). executor = full write access.
